2609.02291.title: VoRTeC: Taming Foundation Flow for One-step Real time Video Compression
2609.02291.paper_summary: Ultra-low bitrate video compression still faces critical challenges: traditional neural video compression inevitably introduces blurring artifacts, while diffusion-based generative video compression suffers from excessive decoding latency and poor temporal consistency. To address these issues, we propose $\mathtt{VoRTeC}$, a Video Compression framework built upon a foundational flow model (Wan2.1). By compactly encoding latent video representations, predicting the positions of compressed representations along flow trajectories, and integrating multi-scale priors, $\mathtt{VoRTeC}$ enables the compressor to harness generative video flow priors effectively. Without accessing the parameters or gradients of flow matching networks, our framework achieves one-step decoding and reconstructions with high perceptual fidelity. Meanwhile, we maintain consistency across frame groups via tail-frame reuse and prior caching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces bit consumption by 58\% compared to prior diffusion-based approaches, with decoding speed boosted by 3 to 197 times: $\mathtt{VoRTeC}$ achieves a decoding speed of 13 FPS at 720p and 32 FPS at 480p.
2609.02291.paper_summary_zh: 超低比特率視頻壓縮仍面臨關鍵挑戰：傳統神經視頻壓縮不可避免地引入模糊伪影，而基於擴散的生成視頻壓縮則遭受過高的解碼延遲和較差的時間一致性。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了 $\mathtt{VoRTeC}$，這是一個基於基礎流模型（Wan2.1）構建的視頻壓縮框架。通過緊湊地編碼潛在視頻表示，預測壓縮表示在流軌跡上的位置，並整合多尺度先驗，$\mathtt{VoRTeC}$ 使壓縮器能夠有效利用生成視頻流先驗。在不訪問流匹配網絡的參數或梯度的情況下，我們的框架實現了一步解碼和高感知保真度的重建。同時，我們通過尾幀重用和先驗緩存來保持幀組之間的一致性。大量實驗表明，我們的方法相比於先前的基於擴散的方法減少了58\%的比特消耗，解碼速度提升了3到197倍：$\mathtt{VoRTeC}$ 在720p下達到13 FPS，在480p下達到32 FPS。
